_comment: Copy this file to local_config.json and fill in your Drive file ID.
_purpose: Lets the local Sync button pull Quarter Target.xlsx from Drive, the same way the GitHub Action does. Without this, local sync only pulls Gmail; Quarter Target stays at whatever's on disk.
_how_to_find_file_id: Open Quarter Target.xlsx in Google Drive in a browser. The URL is https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/THIS_PART/edit — copy that string.
